risks.risk: No accountable independent statistical reviewer and release reviewer are assigned for beta or stable publication.
risks.impact: A sole owner can miss correctness or release-boundary defects and can override hosted controls.
risks.control: Keep beta and stable publication blocked; pre-alpha status and unsupported scope remain explicit.
risks.closure_evidence: Named reviewers approve the exact candidate and the release checklist.

risks.risk: Kamino and lme4 timing runs share physical hardware and a one-thread policy but use different OS/BLAS stacks and optimizer algorithms.
risks.impact: Observed ratios cannot establish implementation superiority or the proposed InstEval-within-2x objective.
risks.control: Label every ratio observational-only and make no comparative performance claim.
risks.closure_evidence: A matched runtime, BLAS, precision, optimizer-policy experiment replaces this baseline.

risks.risk: The dedicated workstation run does not isolate CPU affinity, frequency, thermal state, or all background activity.
risks.impact: Small timing changes may reflect environmental noise.
risks.control: Use distributions, retain raw samples, investigate changes above 20%, and rerun on the same profile before decisions; shared CI enforces only completion and resource ceilings.
risks.closure_evidence: A controlled runner records affinity, power, thermal, and repeated-run variance.

risks.risk: SciPy SuperLU repeats symbolic ordering and is not an SPD Cholesky backend; symbolic time is not separately exposed.
risks.impact: General sparse scaling and fill can degrade on structures outside the pinned corpus.
risks.control: Retain fill, dimension, resource, and correctness ceilings; unsupported or over-limit structures fail closed.
risks.closure_evidence: The sparse-Cholesky ADR is resolved with matched correctness, fill, memory, wheel, and license evidence.

risks.risk: Benchmarks cover representative single-group models and InstEval, not every supported formula shape or adversarial fill pattern.
risks.impact: Capacity may be lower for unmeasured accepted structures.
risks.control: Scope results to named workloads; enforce structural preflight limits and add a manifested case before making a new capacity claim.
risks.closure_evidence: Expanded benchmark manifests cover each newly claimed structure and scale.

risks.risk: Prediction bundles still reject rank-deficient, categorical-random, nested, and crossed fits, and bootstrap interval coverage is not claimed.
risks.impact: Users cannot safely persist those fits or infer nominal bootstrap coverage from current evidence.
risks.control: Capabilities fail closed and documentation keeps both limitations explicit.
risks.closure_evidence: A separately versioned artifact-recovery gate and locked outer-coverage study pass.
